closed_set_training_entity_probe.finding: In-distribution training entities are linearly separable in representation space.

open_set_held_out_dev_entity_retrieval.finding: Held-Out Entity Discrimination: Nearest-neighbor entity retrieval on held-out unseen entities achieves 90.00% (Chance baseline: 5.56%, Permutation control: 8.33%). This empirically confirms that representations of distinct queries referring to the same held-out entity cluster together.
